prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1368; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with a wrist fracture. Over the course of 16 visits, care consisted of immobilization, serial imaging, hand therapy, and follow-up assessments. Physical examination findings are consistent with the reported fracture in some respects, including localized tenderness and reduced grip strength, while other tests, such as neurovascular checks and range-of-motion measures in unaffected joints, have remained within normal limits. No prior injury to the same area is documented in the available history. The course of treatment extended somewhat beyond what is typical for an uncomplicated fracture of this type, reflecting a slower recovery trajectory. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicated or repeated charges for the same services. At this time, it is not yet clear whether the presenting injury is entirely attributable to this collision, and further clinical correlation is recommended before a causation opinion is finalized.
